text_block_list.text:
It was a day off,
and having some rare free time on my
hands,
I was about to head toward the station area
when...
Oh, are you heading out too?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hup!
choice_data_list: Whoa?!

text_block_list.text:
Out of nowhere,
Mr. C.B. dropped down from a tree...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Nice weather today, perfect for going out.
Where are you off to?
choice_data_list: Just by the station... How about you?
Just by the station... How about you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Me? Well, I'm—

Right then,
a certain past event flashed through my
mind.

Mr. C.B.
searching for a place to lift her spirits
for vocal lessons.
With every place we visited,
I felt like I caught a glimpse of her artistic
sensibility—

Even if I couldn't read her mind back
then,
maybe today,
I could finally figure it out!
choice_data_list: I know, let me guess your destination!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Hahaha! Now that sounds fun!
Sure, let's see you guess it!
choice_data_list: Alright, got it!
Okay, deal!

text_block_list.text:
And so,
a guessing game for Mr. C.B.'s destination
began...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Oops, my bad!
I drove the wrong way!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to get Maruzen to give me driving
lessons sometime.
Still, that was a blast!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Scored some sweet prizes,
and even got snacks out of it!
Man, it's been ages since I had sauce-flavored
dagashi!
choice_data_list: Glad you managed to win so much!
Glad we managed to win so much!

text_block_list.text:
An arcade where you can escape the
ordinary.
She seems to be having a wonderful time.
Which means this has to be—!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, though. This isn't the place.
Nice line of thought, though!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Here's a hint, then! I was bored,
so I was thinking,
'I wanna have some fun~.'
choice_data_list: A place to have fun, you say...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was a lot of walking!
The giant maze was pretty neat!
choice_data_list: Refusing to leave until you've exp...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well,
you've gotta wonder what's down the road
not taken, right? Thanks to that,
I got to see every single doll at all the
dead ends!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's hit the drop tower next.
Plummeting straight down from up high!
You don't get a view like that unless you're
a hawk!

She seems to be enjoying the amusement park
to the fullest.
Seeing her this happy gave me a good feeling,
but—
choice_data_list: Is this the right place?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hm? Nope, strike two!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what's next?
Where are you gonna take me next? Ahaha!
choice_data_list: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Alright, one more hint!
It's not very far away.
choice_data_list: In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Phew, thanks for the meal~!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The croquettes here really are delicious.
I pick some up on the way home every now
and then to eat with yuzu kosho.
choice_data_list: Instead of sauce?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it gives it a nice tangy kick... Wait,
you've got
croquette crumbs all over your mouth!
Ahaha!

Hurriedly wiping my mouth,
seeing her having so much fun made me
certain.
Close to the academy, grab-and-go snacks,
and mingling with shopkeepers.
choice_data_list: Is this the right place?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Aww, too bad.

Wrong again... In the end,
I spent her entire day off
without bringing her to the place she wanted
to go.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Don't look so down.
It's not like I didn't have fun, you know?
choice_data_list: But you had somewhere else you ori...
But you had somewhere else you ori...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... If you worry about it like that,
it's just gonna make me feel bad.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Alright,
let me take you to the correct place.

Following Mr. C.B., we ended up
right back at the school gates where we
first met.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Right here. This is the answer.
choice_data_list: ...What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I never had a destination in mind.
I just stepped outside with nowhere to go.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I just climbed up that tree,
looked at the scenery,
and wondered if there was anything interesting
around~.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: And then, you came along.
choice_data_list: So you mean there was no right ans...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No, there was a proper 'right answer.'
Because you came up with something so
interesting.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I had a great time.
Tagging along while you racked your brain,
and playing together wherever we went!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to have a fun time,
and you gave me exactly that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So that means this very spot where I ran
into you
was the right place all along!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Convinced?
choice_data_list: That feels kinda like cheating...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Honestly, I think so too!
Still,
let's do the guessing game again sometime!

A wave of relief washed over me alongside
my exhaustion.
Knowing that I truly managed to show Mr.
C.B. a good time.

And once again,
I was reminded that she's a true free
spirit,
and completely unpredictable.
